t: This is the Design Museum in Kensington, which shows product, industrial, graphic, fashion and architectural design. It won the European Museum of the Year Award in 2018, and it runs as a registered charity, so ticket money goes toward curating new exhibitions. The name to know is Terence Conran. He is credited with designing it, and he founded the museum in 1989, originally in Shad Thames. He also founded the household retailer Habitat in 1964. Thomas Heatherwick said Conran moved Britain forward and made it an influence around the world.
